text: The group ring k[G] of a finite group G over a field k decomposes (when char(k)∤|G|) as:
choices: k^|G| (direct product of |G| copies of k)
a product of matrix algebras Mₙᵢ(k) by Maschke + Artin-Wedderburn
explanation: Maschke+Artin-Wedderburn: k[G] ≅ ⊕Mₙᵢ(Dᵢ) where Dᵢ are division algebras over k. Over ℂ this is ⊕Mₙᵢ(ℂ); the nᵢ are the dimensions of irreducible representations.
